records.custodian: National Bank of Serbia vaults, Belgrade
records.source_title: National Bank of Serbia, Annual Report 2024
records.notes: The NBS Annual Report 2024 section 'Structure and profitability of FX reserves' lists the components of FX reserves at 31 December 2024 as foreign securities (59.16%), FX funds in accounts abroad (22.04%), gold in NBS vaults (13.26%), foreign cash and SDRs. The whole 48.1-tonne gold holding is placed in the NBS's own vaults; no foreign custodian appears. Storage, not management.

not_found.note: Norges Bank's own 'FAQ about Norges Bank' page (norges-bank.no/en/topics/about/faq-about-norges-bank/, published 12 February 2025), answer to 'How large are the gold reserves in Norges Bank?': the bank sold its gold bars 'with the exception of seven gold bars reserved for exhibition purposes and 3 1/2 tons of gold coins that were part of the "gold transport" to England in 1940', and 'Gold is no longer included in Norges Bank's international reserves.' The residual holding is acknowledged but no storage institution or location is named. Confirmed blank.

Central Bank of Nigeria IFRS Financial Statements 2015 and Financial Statements 2013 (both full PDFs downloaded from cbn.gov.ng and searched for 'gold'): the only gold text is the reserve-asset accounting policy ('Gold reserves are held for long-term purposes and are not being traded') plus a balance-sheet line. No custodian or location named. Confirmed blank.

Bank Indonesia Laporan Keuangan Bank Indonesia 2025 (LKBI-2025.pdf, full PDF downloaded from bi.go.id and searched for 'emas', 'kustodian', 'penitipan', 'Bank of England'): gold appears only as a balance-sheet line ('Emas 198,350,642') and in the reserve-asset definitions. The one 'Bank of England' mention is an unrelated ASEAN regional seminar. No custodian named. Confirmed blank for this source.

National Bank of Georgia Annual Report 2024 (annual-eng-2024.pdf, full PDF downloaded from nbg.gov.ge and searched): Note 8 'MONETARY GOLD' gives 229,478 troy ounces purchased in 2024 with price and value only; the reserve-management narrative says the gold bars were bought 'from LBMA-accredited companies' but names no storage institution. The only custody language in the report concerns IMF-quota securities and the World Bank RAMP global custodian, not gold. Confirmed blank.

Central Bank of Kenya Annual Financial Statement 2011 (full PDF downloaded from centralbank.go.ke): note 10 'Balances due from banking institutions and gold holdings' carries the gold as a single line (USD 76m) in the currency-concentration tables with no custodian or location named. Confirmed blank for this source.

IMF Country Report, 'Montenegro: Central Bank Transparency Code Review' (April 2025), fetched and read: the review does not mention gold, storage, custody or vault locations at all and names no custodian. The IMF Central Bank Transparency Code route is dry for Montenegro. Confirmed blank.

HKMA, 'The Exchange Fund' financial statements chapter (hkma.gov.hk/media/eng/publication-and-research/annual-report/2013/16_The_Exchange_Fund.pdf), read: Note 15 'Gold' gives the holding as 66,798 ounces and states only 'The fair value of gold is based on quoted price in an active market.' No custodian or location. Confirmed blank for this source.

Central Bank of Lesotho Annual Financial Statements year ended 2023 (full PDF downloaded from server.centralbank.org.ls and searched): there is no gold note; 'gold' appears only in the statutory text about revaluation of assets 'denominated in, gold or foreign currencies, or Special Drawing Rights'. No gold holding note and no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Bank of Namibia Annual Report (BON-ANNUAL-REPORT-30-MARCH.pdf, full PDF downloaded from bon.com.na and searched): the reserve-management section 'Introduction of gold into the reserve portfolio' says the Bank 'made advanced progress in formalising the groundwork for including gold within the official reserve portfolio during 2025' and that inclusion will follow 'once all governance matters have been finalised'. No gold is yet held and no custodian is named. Confirmed blank.
Closed by the ECCB finding already on file: the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank holds no gold at all, so Montserrat has no gold custody tie to record. No new document read.

Central Bank of Seychelles International Reserves Management Report 2025 and CBS Annual Report 2025 (both full PDFs downloaded from nationalassembly.sc and searched for 'gold'): the reserves report does not mention gold at all; the annual report mentions gold only as a global asset class and in connection with commemorative coins. No gold custody note, no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Bank of Jamaica Annual Report 2025 (boj.org.jm/2025-boj-annual-report-final/, which serves the PDF directly; full PDF downloaded and searched): 'gold' appears only in an art-exhibition title and in the statutory list of permitted reserve assets ('include, inter alia, (a) gold; ...'). No gold holding note and no custodian. Confirmed blank.

National Bank of Moldova Financial statements 2024 (Financial statements 2024_eng_public.pdf, full PDF downloaded from bnm.md): Note 8 'Monetary gold' reads in full that the gold 'comprises 74,133.48 grams of pure gold ... in the form of bullions of Good Delivery standard quality (based on the requirements of the London Bullion Market Association)' plus the revaluation basis. No custodian or location named anywhere in the accounting policy either. Confirmed blank.

Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan Annual Report 2025 (Annual report_2025.pdf, full PDF downloaded from uploads.cbar.az): section 2.4 'Storage and management of international gold and foreign exchange reserves held by the Central Bank' describes tranches, currency composition (93% USD, 1% CNY/QAR, 6% SDR) and external managers, but says nothing about gold storage and names no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Department of Finance Canada, 'Official International Reserves - October 5, 2026' (canada.ca monthly official international reserves, data to 29 September 2026), fetched and read: the reserves table carries the row 'Gold | 0', and Table 7 shows zero gold for every year-end from 2016 to 2026, with small amounts only for 2014 and 2015. Canada's holding is nil, so there is no custodian to record. Closed.

Bank of Israel Financial Statements for 2024 (financial-statements-2024-full.pdf, full English PDF downloaded from boi.org.il, 206,324 characters of extracted text): the word 'gold' does not appear anywhere in the document; the reserves are described only as foreign currency and securities holdings. No gold holding and no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Central Bank of Libya Annual Report 2021 (65th, Annual-Report-2021.pdf from cbl.gov.ly). The Arabic text layer is unusable, so all 93 pages were rasterised and OCR'd locally with tesseract -l ara. Only one page (p.66) mentions monetary gold: it reports that the monetary gold balance in the currency-issue assets stayed at about LYD 46.9 million, 0.1 per cent of those assets. No custodian, institution or storage location anywhere in the report. Confirmed blank for this source.

Central Bank of Sudan 58th Annual Report 2018 and Annual Report 2016 (both full PDFs downloaded and searched): gold appears throughout as export policy, gold-purchase price differentials and the 'Gold Fund Certificates (Bareeg)' scheme; the only holding reference is a balance-sheet line 'Gold Reserve'. No custodian or location named. Confirmed blank.

Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan Annual Report 2003/04 (Annual_report_RMA_2003_04.pdf, the only RMA report PDF a search surfaced; full PDF read): '3. Gold and Precious Metals' appears as a balance-sheet line only, with no custodian or location. Current RMA annual reports were not reached from search. Blank for this source.

Central Bank of The Bahamas: the only annual-report-with-financial-statements URL a search returned (centralbankbahamas.com/viewPDF/documents/2022-05-05-11-51-31-CBOB-2021-Annual-Report-and-Financial-Statements.pdf) returns HTTP 404; the other hits are monthly Statements of Assets and Liabilities, which carry no custody note. Not reached this round.

National Bank of Rwanda: no BNR financial statements PDF surfaced from search; the Rwandan press reporting that search returned (New Times, 'Rwanda to add gold to foreign reserves portfolio in next fiscal year' and 'Central bank bullish about Rwanda's investment in gold reserves') describes gold as a planned addition to the reserve portfolio and names no custodian. Not reached this round.

Central Bank of Armenia Annual Report 2022 (Annual_Report_2022.pdf, cba.am), read right through the notes in three passes: the contents list all notes 1-32 and none is devoted to gold; the word 'gold' appears only in the profit-allocation policy ('revaluation and acquisition of gold, SDR, foreign currency and their equivalents'). No gold note and no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Banco Central de Nicaragua, Informe de Estados Financieros 2024 and Notas complementarias a los Estados Financieros Julio 2025 (both full PDFs downloaded from bcn.gob.ni): gold appears only in the statutory revaluation wording and as a 0.0003 percent line ('Oro') in the reserve composition; the auditors mention 'confirmaciones externas de los custodios internacionales' for investments generally, naming no institution and not referring to gold. Confirmed blank.

Bank of Sierra Leone Financial Statements 2024 and Annual Report and Statement of Accounts 2023 (both full PDFs downloaded from bsl.gov.sl): accounting policy (v) 'Gold' covers valuation only; the 'Gold stock' balance-sheet line is given without location; the 2023 report's board section on 'BSL's Investment in Gold' is about buying domestic gold and names no storage institution. Confirmed blank.

Central Bank of The Gambia annual report (cbg.gm/downloads-file/0c006e2d-cd9b-11ef-8725-02e599c15748, full PDF downloaded): the only gold reference is section 5.3.2 'Commemorative Coins' - 'The Central Bank continues to hold gold and silver commemorative coins.' No monetary gold note and no custodian. Confirmed blank.

Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe: the Herald report 'Auditors BDO confirm Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe's gold balance', fetched and read, quotes BDO only on 'conducting physical verification, and assessing controls in place over safeguarding and recording the gold' and names no vault, refinery or institution. No RBZ financial-statements PDF surfaced from search. Not filable this round.

Bank of Zambia: boz.zm serves only a 9.9 kB JavaScript shell to plain curl on both its root and its annual-reports path, and no BoZ annual report or financial statements PDF was returned by search (results were Zambian commercial banks). Needs a hand check.

Banco Central del Uruguay: bcu.gub.uy fails TLS verification through this sandbox's proxy (unable to get local issuer certificate) on its Estados Contables page, and search returned only BROU (a state commercial bank) and Ministry of Finance documents, not the BCU's own notes. Needs a hand check.

Centrale Bank van Curacao en Sint Maarten: exch.centralbank.cw fails TLS verification through this sandbox's proxy (certificate subject name mismatch), and search returned only Curacao Chronicle press write-ups of the annual reports, which mention a 2022 'gold transaction' and 2024 gold revaluation gains but name no custodian. Needs a hand check.

Banque Centrale de Djibouti, Rapport Annuel 2023 and bcd-rapport-financiers-2021 (both full PDFs downloaded from banque-centrale.dj): the reserve-composition table carries the line 'Or monetaire 0 0 0' - the monetary gold holding is nil in every column. No gold and no custodian. Closed.

Bank of Guyana quarterly/statistical report Sep2021.pdf (full PDF downloaded from bankofguyana.org.gy): gold appears as a 'Gold' column in the assets table and throughout as gold-mining output and exports; no custody note and no institution named. The Bank's own audited financial statements did not surface in search. Blank for this source.

Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) Sixtieth Annual Report (Sixtieth_Annual_Report-EN.pdf, sama.gov.sa), read in two passes including the SAMA Balance Sheet section: the Issuance Department balance sheet shows 'Gold (note 2-g) 1,623,503' and note 2-g gives only the valuation rate ('gold held as a currency cover is valued at a rate of one Saudi Riyal per 0.20751 gram'). Note 4 describes SAMA acting as custodian for government agencies' assets, not gold. No custodian or storage location named anywhere. Confirmed blank.

Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas: the BSP Publications and Reports page (bsp.gov.ph/SitePages/MediaAndResearch/PublicationsAndReports.aspx) was fetched but renders its Annual Report links as 'Full Report | Archives' without any URL in the page text, and no BSP annual report or financial statements PDF was returned by three searches (results were Philippine commercial banks). Not reached this round; needs a hand check of the BSP site.
Central Bank of Myanmar: no CBM annual report or financial statements PDF surfaced in search (results were Myanmar commercial banks and an IMF staff report). Not reached this round.
Central Bank of Belize: the 'Annual financial statement for the year 2024' page at centralbank.org.bz was downloaded but contains no PDF link in its markup. Not reached this round.
